notes.title: Latex Tentacles Release Update
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

We regret to announce that the release of Latex Tentacles, originally scheduled for this month, will be delayed to ensure better quality.

We sincerely apologize for this second delay. While the game is largely complete, this is the development team's first attempt at this particular gameplay style, and there are still some details we're not fully satisfied with. After careful consideration, Mango Party will be assisting the team to make the game even better.

We expect the game to be released in April, with the exact date to be announced in a future update. Thank you for your continued patience and understanding.

Mango Party
